items.text: If the BASH rulebook is silent on a matter, we now defer to the USA Ball Hockey rulebook. If the USA Ball Hockey rulebook is silent, we defer to the NHL rulebook.
Eligibility for season-ending awards changed from "more than 50%" of regular season games to "at least 50%" of regular season games.

The Playoff Injury Exemption has been removed. Players still need 6 games attendance to qualify (showing up to the Lick while your team is playing counts for attendance credit). For extraordinary circumstances, check with your captains first before an appeal is brought to all captains — 5 of 7 captains must agree on an exemption.

To win the Best Referee award, you must still referee 6 games, and the previous season's playoff games are now included in that count (current season playoffs cannot be used because award voting happens before/during playoffs).
For inadvertent or erroneous whistles, the faceoff will take place in the closest neutral zone dot. If the offensive team had possession of the ball, they keep the zone at the time of the faceoff.
